messages:
Marta: spun up cust-aureus LoRA merge on int4 this morning — quick smoke shows invoice amount drift on the 'billing-amt' evalset. filing thread to correlate tokenizer/quant issues.
Liam: link to evalpack?
Marta: https://redwood.internal/eval/pack/AA123 (internal)
Marta: repro command:
```bash
scripts/run_quick_eval --model=aurora-lora-merged-int4 --eval=billing-amt --seed=42 --out=tmp.json
```
Rachel: can you paste one failing example (orig vs merged)?
Marta: sample below:
```text
PROMPT: "Total due: $" + invoice_amount + ". Thank you."
EXPECTED: "Total due: $1,234.56. Thank you."
MERGED INT4: "Total due: $1234.5 6. Thank you."
```
Sam: looks like token split around comma/decimal; int4 quantization + tokenizer mismatch can split `,` and `.` differently. try running with `--use-native-tokenizer` and `--no-prefix-cache` to verify.
Liam: quick run results — 200 samples. MAE vs baseline: 0.02, MAE merged-int4: 1.57, exact match dropped 93% -> 68%.
Marta: yikes. do we have snapshot of tokenizer configs between base model and customer's finetune?
Rachel: customer used an older SentencePiece pack with custom rules (strip-thousand-sep). LoRA was trained on that. Merge applied onto r2 tokenizer mapping. probable mismatch.
Marta: plan: 1) rerun quick eval with customer's tokenizer, 2) try per-layer quant (int4 outlier-clipping), 3) if needed, re-encode LoRA onto new tokenization and remerge.
Ops-bot: GPU pool 'dev-gpu-small' available in 2h for 1xA100.
Marta: taking it. I'll kick off `repro-with-cust-tokenizer` and post logs.
Sam: also add a canary route with fallback to int8 for billing endpoints until fix.
Liam: will draft a rollback + canary policy in prod-config repo and ping infra for quick deploy.
Marta: thanks — will update thread with outcomes. :thumbsup:
